editor-mode-label: How do you want to set the goal?
editor-mode-manual: I already know my daily calories
editor-body-intro: Height, weight and activity are used to estimate the calories that keep your weight stable. They are used for this estimate only.
editor-disclaimer: This is an estimate for information only. It is not medical advice.
editor-target-hint: The estimate is for keeping your weight. Enter the target you want.
assumptions-AGE_IN_COMPLETED_YEARS: Age is counted in completed years, from the date of birth.
assumptions-MAINTENANCE_ENERGY_NOT_A_TAR: This is the energy to keep your weight, not a weight loss or weight gain target.
assumptions-LARGE_INDIVIDUAL_VARIATION: Individual needs vary a lot, so your real figure can differ noticeably.
assumptions-INCLUDES_GROWTH_ALLOWANCE: An allowance for growth is included.
assumptions-unknown: Other assumptions of the method apply.
screen-subtitle: Choose how you want to set it. You can change it later.
screen-parameters-unavailable: Saved measurements could not be loaded, so the form starts empty.
editor-pace-hint: Pick a pace to fill in a suggested target, or type your own. Both are only guides.
editor-pace-calculation: {{maintenance}} kcal to keep your weight {{adjustment}} kcal = {{result}} kcal a day.
editor-pace-limited: The suggestion stops at the limit the app recommends.
kcal-warning-message: This amount is outside the range usually recommended. We suggest talking to your dietitian before using it. You can still save it.
